Celadon City Pokemon Gym Leader: Erika\nThe Nature-Loving Princess!
Oh, my!\nWere you staring at me?
Seeing me come out of the Game Corner with a whole pile of Coins...\nAnd grinning to myself?\nYou were, weren't you?

I heard Johto also has a city called Goldenrod that has many tall buildings.\nI would love to visit there sometime.

then.text: The Celadon Department Store offers the widest range of items!\nYou can buy anything you want!

It’s weird seeing so many trainers here… all for politics, not battles.
I just want them to open the voting kiosks already. Standing here’s making me nervous.

list.text: Sorry, the Pokémon Association is closed for now. They are organizing everything for the next elections that will happen soon.
Only Pokémon Association Admin members are allowed to enter.

then.text: By a considerable margin, the new president of the Kanto Pokémon Association is…

else.text: By a narrow margin, the new president of the Kanto Pokémon Association is…

list.text: Giovanni!
\f[facegiovanni]Giovanni: \bToday, Kanto begins its ascent out of chaos, into strenght!
\f[facegiovanni]\bWeakness has infected our halls of power for too long.\nThat ends now.
\f[facegiovanni]\bWe rise under leadership that commands respect, eliminates doubt, and brings order to every city, every Gym, every Trainer.
\f[facegiovanni]\bWith experienced Leaders by my side, we will silence the chaos… and those who fuel it.
The crowds disperse… but an uneasy tension lingers in the air.
\f[faceyellow]Yellow: \rHey \PN!
\f[faceyellow]\rIt’ll be hours before the results are ready. We can go grab something to eat - no point just standing around.
\f[faceyellow]\rLet's go?

branches.text: Several hours pass as the final votes are counted…
\f[faceyellow]\rNo problem. Just be back before they announce the results.

list.text: \f[faceyellow]Yellow: \rOh no, that's really bad!
\f[faceyellow]\rI can't believe Giovanni was able to win the Elections!
\f[faceyellow]\rThat's a complete disaster!
\f[faceyellow]\rIt seems that nobody remembers what happened 4 years ago!
\f[faceyellow]\rAnd where is Red in that important moment?\nWhy nobody believes in his words about Giovanni?!
\f[faceyellow]Yellow: \rI can’t believe this…\nAfter everything… after Red stopped him four years ago…
\f[faceyellow]\rHow do they not see it? Giovanni’s Team Rocket - he always has been.
\f[faceyellow]\rIt’s like… they just forgot.
\f[faceyellow]\rOr maybe… they just don’t care.
\f[faceyellow]\rRed should’ve been here. I know he sent that message, but… his voice might’ve changed things.
\f[faceyellow]\rBut he stayed on Mt. Silver.\nI guess… he didn’t think it would come to this.
\f[faceyellow]\rI… I need some air.\nStay sharp, okay?\nThis isn’t over.
